quote: A tiny squirrel, a huge adventure.
syn: A cheerful platform adventure. Run, jump and copy enemy abilities as Nova the squirrel across colorful hand-crafted worlds.
author: NovaSquirrel

syn: A top-down dungeon adventure in the classic style. Explore dark dungeons, fight monsters, find new gear and uncover hidden rooms.
author: Nathan Tolbert

quote: The kraken is climbing. Keep clearing.
syn: A falling-block puzzler under attack. Stack and clear blocks to repair your tower while a giant kraken climbs up from the sea to pull it down.
author: Matt Hughson

syn: A short and charming platformer about a little black cat. Leap across rooftops, hills and old ruins at your own pace.
author: Jono Shields

syn: A retro platformer starring two dragon brothers. Tight jumps, trap-filled stages and old-school challenge, straight from the NES era.
author: Garydos

quote: Protect the town at all costs.
syn: Missile defense in the classic arcade style. Watch the skies and intercept incoming missiles before they level your town.
author: Damian Yerrick

quote: Match it. Merge it. Beat the board.
syn: A symbol-merging puzzle game. Slide and merge matching symbols into higher tiers and chase the biggest combo you can build.
author: copyrat90

syn: The classic sliding-number puzzle on NES. Merge matching tiles, double your way up, and try to reach the legendary 2048 tile.
author: tsone

syn: A bundle of 13 bite-size mini-games made by the GBA homebrew community for the GBA Microjam 2023 — a little bit of everything in one cartridge.
author: gbadev community

syn: A one-room brawler where the weapons are the furniture. Rearrange the room, fling chairs and tables, and wreck your rival before they wreck you.
author: Damian Yerrick

syn: The classic card-matching memory game. Flip the cards, remember what you saw, and find every pair — solo or against a friend.
author: Damian Yerrick

syn: A bluffing party game with a toy revolver and paint capsules. Pull the trigger, pass it on, and hope your luck holds out longer than everyone else.
author: Damian Yerrick

quote: Somewhere out there is a kitten.
syn: A robot. A kitten. Hundreds of strange objects to inspect in between. The cult zen classic about finding one specific kitten in a field of delightful nonsense.
author: Damian Yerrick

syn: A falling-block puzzler with a twist: the well itself shifts and adjusts as you play, so no two games ever stack up the same way.
author: Dave VanEe

quote: One careful step at a time.
syn: Cross the magic floor one careful step at a time. A tiny logic puzzle about paths, tiles, and not painting yourself into a corner.
author: Damian Yerrick

quote: Your cat is in the sky. Go get her.
syn: Bounce, stomp and fly higher and higher to rescue your cat from the sky. A fast, joyful platformer loved across the whole homebrew scene.
author: Tangram Games

syn: A pocket roguelike: descend the tower, grab the ham, and try not to die on the way down. Every run builds a brand-new tower.
author: Ben Smith (binji)

syn: Tap along to the beat through a pocket rhythm adventure. Timing is everything, and the tunes are pure Game Boy.
author: martendo

syn: A lobster. Lightning. Chaos. A bite-sized arcade action game with the hero you never expected and claws you will not forget.
author: Dave VanEe

syn: Grow big, shrink small, and use your size to solve each room. A clever puzzle platformer built entirely around one great idea.
author: Matthew D. Steele

quote: A whole city in your pocket.
syn: A full city builder in color on the Game Boy Color: lay roads, zone districts, supply power and watch your tiny city grow.
author: AntonioND

syn: A Game Boy Color brick-breaker with a bounce: clear the blocks, keep the ball alive, and chase the high score.
author: DevEd

syn: Build a tiny city on your GBA: zones, power, roads and budgets, all simulated in your pocket.
author: AntonioND

syn: Bomb, blast and trap your way through maze arenas in this SNES homebrew take on the classic bomber formula.
author: 1r3n33

syn: A pocket-size puzzle game set on tiny planets: push, rotate and think your way through bite-sized worlds that fit in the palm of your hand.
author: Javier Degirolmo (Sik)

syn: Explore a sprawling castle full of secrets, traps and treasure in this Mega Drive adventure platformer, built as a love letter to the classics.
author: Javier Degirolmo (Sik)

syn: A western quick-draw duel. Watch your opponent, wait for the signal and fire first — one twitch too early and it is over.
author: Adrián JG (ajgalan)

syn: Run your own little game studio: hire staff, ship games and keep the company alive in this charming management sim.
author: Dr. Ludos

syn: Guide a growing worm through tight puzzle rooms. Every move counts when the only way out is through the wyrmhole.
author: Quinn Painter

quote: An RPG world in your pocket.
syn: A story-driven role-playing demo with exploration and turn-based battles, built by a team of Game Boy homebrew veterans.
author: ISSOtm, Kai, Parzival & Charmy

syn: Rotate and link circuit pieces to connect every endpoint. A calm, clever puzzler that ramps up gently.
author: Quinn Painter

syn: The daily word-guessing game, faithfully shrunk onto a Game Boy. Guess the hidden five-letter word in six attempts.
author: bbbbbr

syn: A tiny turtle with a squishy shell bounces through hand-made platform levels full of spikes and surprises.
author: Chris Cacciatore (cppchriscpp)

syn: A fast auto-running platformer. Time your jumps as the renegade sprints through traps at full speed.
author: Quinn Painter

syn: A block-pushing puzzle adventure. Plan every shove — one wrong push can seal the room for good.
author: Martin Holtkamp (mholtkamp)

syn: A vertical shoot-'em-up packed into a Game Boy Color cartridge. Dodge, blast and escape the obliterizer.
author: João Godinho (jcnmsg)

syn: A falling-block matching puzzler with chain reactions. Clear the stack before it buries you.
author: furrtek

syn: The classic flood-fill puzzle: turn the whole board one color, one tap at a time, before your moves run out.
author: Oliver Balfour

syn: A terminal-hacking adventure played through a fake operating system. Explore files, crack passwords, follow the trail.
author: Ian Langworth (statico)

syn: Pilot a rescue craft over Jupiter's moon Europa and bring stranded astronauts home in this arcade action game.
author: godai / Gniazdo Światów

syn: Explore a twisting labyrinth, gather keys and find the exit before the maze swallows you whole.
author: godai / Gniazdo Światów

syn: A little mail robot plans its routes through puzzle depots. Deliver every parcel without running dry.
author: Tobias Rojahn (MasterIV)

syn: A tight precision platformer. Short hops, sharp spikes and the constant urge to try just one more time.
author: Graham Coulby (IonicLimb)

syn: A real first-person shooter running on a Game Boy Advance, with chunky voxel graphics and castle sieges.
author: John Tsiombikas (MutantStargoat)

syn: Throw your magic hat to possess enemies and steal their powers in this inventive platform adventure.
author: Tapir Game Studios

syn: Defend the city as meteors rain from the sky. Fast arcade action with escalating chaos.
author: Dr. Ludos

syn: A moody action adventure about a lone knight crossing a cursed land under an endless purple night.
author: Corwin & Gwilym Kuiper

syn: A deep strategy adventure among floating islands: gather resources, grow your island, recruit a crew and fight turn-based sky battles.
author: Evan Bowman (evanbowman)

syn: A dragon-themed shoot-'em-up for the Master System. Blast through waves of enemies in fast side-scrolling action.
author: haroldo-ok

syn: A food-based shoot-'em-up made for the SMS Power coding competition. Blast mutant snacks across frantic stages.
author: haroldo-ok

syn: A platform adventure born in the SMS Power 2018 coding competition, rebuilt for the Master System.
author: haroldo-ok

syn: Conway's Game of Life on the Master System. Seed a pattern and watch generations of cells live, die and evolve.
author: tibonev

syn: A maze-chase romp from the SMS Power 2021 competition. Clear the maze, dodge the ghosts and chase the high score.
author: SteveProXNA (StevePro Studios)

syn: A classic 8-bit shoot-'em-up for the Master System, blasting through pseudo-3D city stages.
author: SteveProXNA

syn: An original Atari 2600 adventure: play a firefly gathering embers through many rooms while the shade hunts you.
author: retroromrunner

syn: A compact Atari 2600 puzzle adventure told through doorways - small, strange and clever.
author: yoyatime
